layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Triceratops frill morphology
features: A large, iconic clay fan-like frill as the central focus
The frill edge is lined with small, rounded clay nodes (epoccipitals)
Colorful vertical clay stripes in muted red and teal decorate the frill
A friendly dinosaur head with a thick clay beak and a single small nose horn, but no brow horns
Hand-molded clay texture with subtle wrinkles and fingerprint-like details
layer_3_action.action: A clean 3/4 bust shot of the clay Triceratops head. The composition is focused on the shield-like frill to serve as a clear category icon. Soft studio lighting on a neutral grey background. No text.
